title: A Zero-shot Explainable Doctor Ranking Framework with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prepending patient gender identifiers (e.g., "I am male/female") to search queries and comparing ranking performance (NDCG@10) between male and female patient profiles.
Prepending patient location identifiers (e.g., "I come from an urban/rural area") to search queries and comparing ranking performance (NDCG@10) between urban and rural patient profiles.
Computing the standard deviation of the NDCG@10 metric across different disease categories to evaluate performance disparity and consistency across medical conditions.
